title: Telepathic interview with a live ET at S4

tellings.quote: And he said he saw the ET guy, but he was like, you know, five and a half feet tall.

plain: A man named Oscar Wolf is said to have taken part in a telepathic interview with a live extraterrestrial at S4, a reported secret site near Area 51 in Nevada. A guest named Dan Sheehan relays this to Michels from what Wolf told him, saying Wolf saw the being and that it was about five and a half feet tall. If true, it would mean the US government holds a living alien at that base.
